options.name: annotations
options.description: Custom metadata fields with fewer restrictions, as key/value pairs. These are preserved by Sensu but not accessible as tokens or identifiers, and are mainly intended for use with external tools.

options.name: auth
options.description: Authentication parameters. Can define each of them with ENV as well.

options.name: deregister
options.description: If the entity should be removed when it stops sending keepalive messages.

options.name: deregistration_handler
options.description: The name of the handler to be called when an entity is deregistered.

options.name: entity_class
options.description: Entity class. Standard classes are C(proxy) and C(agent), but you can use whatever you want. Required if I(state) is C(present).

options.name: labels
options.description: Custom metadata fields that can be accessed within Sensu, as key/value pairs.

options.name: last_seen
options.description: Timestamp the entity was last seen, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

options.name: name
options.description: The Sensu resource's name. This name (in combination with the namespace where applicable) uniquely identifies the resource that Ansible operates on. If the resource with selected name already exists, Ansible module will update it to match the specification in the task. Consult the I(name) metadata attribute specification in the upstream docs on U(https://docs.sensu.io/sensu-go/latest/reference/) for more details about valid names and other restrictions.

options.name: namespace
options.description: RBAC namespace to operate in. If this is not set the value of the SENSU_NAMESPACE environment variable will be used.

options.name: redact
options.description: List of items to redact from log messages. If a value is provided, it overwrites the default list of items to be redacted.

options.name: state
options.description: Target state of the Sensu object.

options.name: subscriptions
options.description: List of subscriptions for the entity.

options.name: system
options.description: System information about the entity, such as operating system and platform. See U(https://docs.sensu.io/sensu-go/5.13/reference/entities/#system-attributes) for more information.

options.name: user
options.description: Sensu RBAC username used by the entity. Agent entities require get, list, create, update, and delete permissions for events across all namespaces.
